hero.headline: The Intelligence Layer Behind Autonomous Hospitality
hero.subheadline: ARRIE helps restaurant networks detect operational risks, coordinate decisions faster, and protect revenue in real time.

industry.headline: Modern restaurant operations were never designed for this level of complexity.

painPoints.title: Fragmented Systems
painPoints.desc: POS, delivery, reservations, inventory — all disconnected.

painPoints.title: Delayed Response
painPoints.desc: Problems are discovered after revenue damage already happened.

painPoints.title: Operational Blind Spots
painPoints.desc: No unified visibility across locations and channels.

painPoints.title: Margin Pressure
painPoints.desc: Rising labor costs, food inflation, delivery commissions.

painPoints.title: Manual Coordination
painPoints.desc: Owners forced to monitor everything and react constantly.

painPoints.title: Reactive Management
painPoints.desc: Decisions made too late, manually, under pressure.

intelligence.headline: Restaurants generate data. Few generate intelligence.
intelligence.body: Most systems collect information. Very few help operators understand what requires attention now. ARRIE continuously interprets operational signals across locations, transforming fragmented data into coordinated action.

capabilities.headline: What ARRIE enables across your network

items.title: Operational Awareness
items.desc: Real-time pulse of every location, unified.

items.title: Revenue Visibility
items.desc: Detect margin threats before they escalate.

items.title: Predictive Alerts
items.desc: Know what will happen, not just what happened.

items.title: Incident Visibility
items.desc: See critical deviations as they emerge.

items.title: Real-Time Pulse
items.desc: Live operational heartbeat of your network.

commandCenter.headline: Your network, visible. Your decisions, accelerated.
commandCenter.body: A new kind of operational interface — designed for executives who need clarity, not clutter. Revenue pulse, live alerts, predictive risk notifications, and coordination streams in one unified view.

networks.headline: Designed for scale. Architected for complexity.
networks.body: Whether you operate 5 locations or 500, ARRIE provides the intelligence infrastructure to manage complexity without adding overhead.

vision.headline: The future of hospitality is not more dashboards.
vision.body: It is operational intelligence that helps businesses respond faster, coordinate better, and protect revenue continuously. ARRIE is building the infrastructure for that future.

finalCta.headline: The next generation of restaurant operations starts here.
